notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of January - December 2005, from volumes 57 and 58 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (57minutesofsanfran2005san and 58minutesofsanfran2005san). Action minutes, as in 1994 - 2003: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote list and, for most actions other than discretionary reviews, the motion number. This batch was read by an external reader (Meta Muse, working from the Internet Archive's one-file djvu text, which has no page breaks) from a written spec, and converted here: every entry's page was located mechanically in the hOCR page split by its case number, its meeting date and its verbatim quote, with pages dated from each meeting's cover page rather than the running headers. Four kinds of finding: what the Commission decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property; landmark actions; and a dated past fact the calendar prints. A continuance, a motion of intent, a failed motion and an item under 'Items to be continued' are not decisions. The minutes name applicants, owners, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any published field, and every sentence of the reader's notes naming a commissioner was removed on ingest.
